```{r testing code snippet}
categorical_cols

```


```{r helper function}
#1. Model evaluation metric :rMSE

calculate_rMSE = function(actual,predicted){
  sqrt(mean((actual-predicted)^2))
}

#2. One-hot encode function 

onehot_encode = function(data,target_col="exam_score", datasetname = "dataset"){
  df = data
  all_cols = setdiff(names(data),target_col)
  
  #get categorical cols - target col
  categorical_cols = colnames(
    data %>%
      select(where(is.character)| where(is.factor)) %>%
      select(-any_of(target_col))
  )
  #get numerical cols - target col
  numercial_cols = setdiff(all_cols,categorical_cols)
  #print result 
  cat(sprintf("Total features ( excluding target): %d\n", length(all_cols)))
  cat(sprintf(" Categorical: %d\n", length(categorical_cols)))
  cat(sprintf(" Numerical: %d\n", length(numercial_cols)))
  
  #create dummy variables for categorical features
  if(length(categorical_cols)>0){
    cat("\nCreating onehot encoded features\n")
    
    dummy_formula = as.formula(paste("~", paste(categorical_cols, collapse = " + ")))
    dummy_model = dummyVars(dummy_formula, data = df, fullRank = TRUE)
    dummy_data = predict(dummy_model, newdata = df)
    dummy_df = as.data.frame(dummy_data)
    
    cat(sprintf("Number of dummy variables created: %d\n", ncol(dummy_df)))
    
    #combine : dummy variables + numerical features + target 
    if(target_col %in% names(df)){
      df_final = cbind(dummy_df, df[,numercial_cols], df[,target_col,drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      df_final = cbind(dummy_df,df[,numercial_cols]) #test dataset 
    }
    } else {
      #No categorical features 
      cat("\n No encoding needed, using numerical features only\n")
      if(target_col %in% names(df)) {
            df_final = cbind(df[, numerical_cols], df[, target_col, drop = FALSE])
        } else {
            df_final = df[, numerical_cols]
        }
    }
    cat(sprintf("\nFinal dataset dimensions: %d rows × %d columns\n", 
                nrow(df_final), ncol(df_final)))
    if(target_col %in% names(df_final)) {
        cat(sprintf("Total features (excluding target): %d\n", ncol(df_final) - 1))
    
      #result 
    result = list(
      data = df_final,
      dummy_model = if(length(categorical_cols)>0) dummy_model else NULL,
      categorical_cols = categorical_cols,
      numercial_cols = numercial_cols
      
    )
    
    return(result)
      
  }
  
  }

cat("\nHelper function created\n")

```

```{r processing training data }

train_clean = onehot_encode(
  data = train,
  target_col = "exam_score",
  datasetname = "Training Data"
)
# Extract results
train_encoded = train_clean$data
dummy_model = train_clean$dummy_model
categorical_cols = train_clean$categorical_cols
numerical_cols = train_clean$numerical_cols
cat("\nEncoded training data:", nrow(train_encoded), "rows ×", ncol(train_encoded), "columns\n")


```
```{r split data after encoding}
# Split 70/30 train-validation
set.seed(123)
train_index = createDataPartition(train_encoded$exam_score, p = 0.7, list = FALSE) #

train_data = train_encoded[train_index, ]
validation_data = train_encoded[-train_index, ]
cat("\nData split complete:\n")
cat("Training set:", nrow(train_data), "rows ×", ncol(train_data), "columns\n")
cat("Validation set:", nrow(validation_data), "rows ×", ncol(validation_data), "columns\n")


```
## Train Random Forest 

```{r train random forest}

install.packages("ranger")
library(ranger)

#1. process names of the cols - RF

predictor_names = names(train_data)
predictor_names = setdiff(predictor_names,"exam_score")
safe_predictors = paste0("`", predictor_names, "`")
formula_rf = paste(safe_predictors, collapse = " + ") 
safe_rf_formula = as.formula(paste("exam_score ~ ", formula_rf))

#2. set up train control
train_control_rftunned = trainControl(
    method = "cv", 
    number = 5,
    verboseIter = TRUE )
 
# Train RF model 
set.seed(123)
model_rf_tuned = train(
      safe_rf_formula,
      data = train_data,
      method = "ranger",
      metric = "RMSE",
      trControl = train_control_rftunned,
      num.tree = 250,
      importance = "impurity",
      tuneGrid = expand.grid(
        mtry = c(5,10,15,20,25,30),
        splitrule = "variance",
        min.node.size = c(5)
      )
      )
      
cat("\nTuning complete\n")
print(model_rf_tuned)
# Get best mtry
best_mtry = model_rf_tuned$bestTune$mtry
cat("\nBest mtry:", best_mtry, "\n")
# Extract results for all mtry values
results_mtry = model_rf_tuned$results
cat("\nAll tuning results:\n")
print(results_mtry)



```
